sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·朗森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth
sentences.zh: 即便是在黑胶唱片时代的夜店做DJ，你每晚也要带着300件心爱的宝贝去工作，然后把DJ台

sentences.en: into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 变成一个充满50年历史精美文物的流动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼出品的《重构者》吧。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, FBI Director James Comey breaks his silence, saying he's, quote, mildly nauseous over the idea that he could have tipped the presidential election.
sentences.zh: 今天，FBI局长詹姆斯·科米打破沉默，称一想到自己可能影响了总统大选，他就感到“轻微恶心”。

sentences.en: And with a fiercely conservative governor leading the fight, is Kentucky about to become the only state in America without a single abortion clinic?
sentences.zh: 在一位立场强硬的保守派州长的领导下，肯塔基州是否即将成为美国唯一一个没有堕胎诊所的州？

sentences.en: It's Thursday, May 4th.
sentences.zh: 今天是5月4日，星期四。

sentences.en: As the old saying goes, for somebody as famous as you, you don't need any introductions, so I'm going to just introduce you as Director of the Federal Bureau of Investigation.
sentences.zh: 俗话说得好，像您这样出名的人不需要介绍，所以我直接介绍您为联邦调查局局长。

sentences.en: On Wednesday morning,
sentences.zh: 周三上午，

sentences.en: James Comey gave his first public explanation for why, less than two weeks before Election Day, he notified Congress about new emails related to the investigation
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯·科米首次公开解释了为什么在选举日前不到两周，他通知国会关于调查的新邮件，

sentences.en: into Hillary Clinton's use of a private email server.
sentences.zh: 这些邮件涉及希拉里·克林顿使用私人邮件服务器的问题。

sentences.en: Matt Apuzzo was there.
sentences.zh: 马特·阿普佐当时在场。

sentences.en: Matt, thank you for coming on.
sentences.zh: 马特，谢谢你来参加节目。

sentences.en: Oh, I was going to say hello.
sentences.zh: 哦，我本来想打个招呼的。

sentences.en: Oh, oh, oh, I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 哦，哦，哦，抱歉。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊，是啊，是啊。

sentences.en: Get in the game.
sentences.zh: 进入状态吧。

sentences.en: Okay, Matt, thank you for coming on.
sentences.zh: 好的，马特，谢谢你来参加节目。

sentences.en: Great to be back, Michael.
sentences.zh: 很高兴回来，迈克尔。

sentences.en: So describe for me this testimony today on Capitol Hill.
sentences.zh: 那么，请为我描述一下今天在国会山的这场听证会。

sentences.en: It was 10 a.m., and the FBI Director, Jim Comey, walks into the Senate Judiciary Committee hearing room.
sentences.zh: 当时是上午10点，FBI局长吉姆·科米走进了参议院司法委员会的听证室。

sentences.en: Thank you for having this annual oversight hearing about the FBI.
sentences.zh: 感谢你们举行这次关于FBI的年度监督听证会。

sentences.en: I know that sounds a little bit like someone saying they're looking forward to going to the dentist, but I really do mean it.
sentences.zh: 我知道这听起来有点像有人说他们期待去看牙医，但我确实是真心的。

sentences.en: And right off the bat, the top Democrat on the committee, Dianne Feinstein, goes into the Hillary Clinton case and his decision-making in that case.
sentences.zh: 听证会一开始，委员会的民主党领袖黛安·范斯坦就切入了希拉里·克林顿案以及他在该案中的决策过程。

sentences.en: Why was it necessary to announce 11 days before a presidential election that you were opening an investigation on a new computer without any knowledge of what was in that computer?
sentences.zh: 为什么在总统大选前11天，在对电脑内容一无所知的情况下，宣布对一台新电脑展开调查是必要的？

sentences.en: Why didn't you just do the investigation as you would normally, with no public announcement?
sentences.zh: 为什么你不像往常一样进行调查，而不公开发布声明呢？

sentences.en: And you could see he got worked up.
sentences.zh: 你可以看出他情绪有些激动。

sentences.en: Look, this was terrible.
sentences.zh: 听着，这太糟糕了。

sentences.en: It makes me mildly nauseous to think that we might have had some impact on the election.
sentences.zh: 一想到我们可能对选举产生了一些影响，我就感到轻微恶心。

sentences.en: But honestly, it wouldn't change the decision.
sentences.zh: 但老实说，这并不会改变我的决定。

sentences.en: Everybody who disagrees with me has to come back to October 28th with me and stare at this and tell me what you would do.
sentences.zh: 所有不同意我的人都必须和我一起回到10月28日，审视这一切，然后告诉我你会怎么做。

sentences.en: Would you speak or would you conceal?
sentences.zh: 你会选择说出来还是隐瞒？

sentences.en: And you could see that he was animated about this.
sentences.zh: 你可以看出他在谈论这个问题时非常激动。

sentences.en: This was not the guy who was so comfortable testifying for the Senate that a lot of staffers jokingly call him Senator Comey.
sentences.zh: 他不再是那个在参议院作证时游刃有余，以至于许多工作人员开玩笑称他为“科米参议员”的人了。

sentences.en: This is a guy who clearly was on his heels trying to explain something that, frankly, a lot of people are just not going to accept his explanations for.
sentences.zh: 他显然处于守势，试图解释一些坦率地说，很多人根本不会接受他解释的事情。

sentences.en: And I've lived my entire career by the tradition that if you can possibly avoid it, you avoid any action in the run-up to an election that might have an impact,
sentences.zh: 我整个职业生涯都遵循一个传统，即如果可能的话，要避免在选举前夕采取任何可能产生影响的行动，

sentences.en: whether it's a dog-catcher election or president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 无论是捕狗官选举还是美国总统选举。

sentences.en: But I sat there that morning and I could not see a door labeled no action here.
sentences.zh: 但那天早上我坐在那里，我找不到一扇标着“不采取行动”的门。

sentences.en: I could see two doors and they were both actions.
sentences.zh: 我看到了两扇门，它们都是行动。

sentences.en: One was labeled speak.
sentences.zh: 一扇标着“说出来”。

sentences.en: The other was labeled conceal.
sentences.zh: 另一扇标着“隐瞒”。

sentences.en: And the way he's framed that makes it really hard to argue against what he did.
sentences.zh: 他这种表述方式让人很难反驳他的做法。

sentences.en: But a lot of people, including some people in the FBI and many people in the Justice Department say, yeah, but that's not actually the choice you had.
sentences.zh: 但很多人，包括FBI内部的一些人和司法部的许多人说，是的，但那并不是你真正面临的选择。

sentences.en: The choice was follow the rules.
sentences.zh: 选择应该是遵守规则。

sentences.en: The FBI's rules, the Justice Department's longstanding guidelines are, we don't talk about our ongoing investigations, we don't confirm what we're investigating,
sentences.zh: FBI的规则和司法部长期以来的指导方针是：我们不谈论正在进行的调查，我们不确认我们正在调查什么，

sentences.en: and we don't do anything that's going to jam up a federal election.
sentences.zh: 而且我们不做任何会干扰联邦选举的事情。

sentences.en: So just follow the guidelines and keep your mouth shut.
sentences.zh: 所以只要遵守准则，闭上嘴就行了。

sentences.en: We just heard Hillary Clinton say she would have won but for this moment.
sentences.zh: 我们刚刚听到希拉里·克林顿说，如果不是因为这一刻，她本会获胜。

sentences.en: You know, if the election had been on October 27th,
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果选举是在10月27日举行，

sentences.en: I'd be your president.
sentences.zh: 我就是你们的总统了。

sentences.en: And it wasn't.
sentences.zh: 但事实并非如此。

sentences.en: It was on October 28th, and there was just a lot of funny business going on around that.
sentences.zh: 选举是在10月28日，当时周围发生了很多奇怪的事情。

sentences.en: Matt, as a reporter who has covered this whole saga the closest, the whole investigation by the FBI into the Hillary Clinton's emails,
sentences.zh: 马特，作为一名最密切跟踪整个事件的记者，即FBI对希拉里·克林顿邮件的整个调查，

sentences.en: what's your biggest takeaways from this testimony by James Comey?
sentences.zh: 你从詹姆斯·科米的这次证词中得到的最大收获是什么？

sentences.en: So I talked with Mike Schmidt and Adam Goldman, and my colleagues who, and we've covered this whole thing for months, and we all agree, he clearly has internalized this.
sentences.zh: 我和迈克·施密特、亚当·戈德曼以及我的同事们谈过，我们几个月来一直报道这件事，我们都同意，他显然已经内化了这一点。

sentences.en: He's clearly hearing the criticism.
sentences.zh: 他显然听到了批评的声音。

sentences.en: I mean, how could you not?
sentences.zh: 我是说，怎么可能听不到呢？

sentences.en: So that was one takeaway.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个收获。

sentences.en: The other takeaway is,
sentences.zh: 另一个收获是，

sentences.en: one of the reasons why Jim Comey feels so strongly about the decisions that he made was because he has framed his choice in a way that gives him only two bad options.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·科米之所以对自己的决定如此坚定，原因之一是他将自己的选择框定为只有两个糟糕的选项。

sentences.en: And this chasm is not something that he is going to build a bridge across to help people who are really critical of his decisions say, oh, I agree, I understand now.
sentences.zh: 而这道鸿沟并不是他能架起桥梁去帮助那些真正批评他决定的人说“哦，我同意，我现在明白了”。

sentences.en: They do not even agree on the framing of the choice he faced.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至在对他所面临的选择的界定上都无法达成一致。

sentences.en: We honestly made a decision between those two choices that even in hindsight, and this has been one of the world's most painful experiences, I would make the same decision.
sentences.zh: 我们诚实地在两个选择之间做出了决定，即使事后看来，这已成为世界上最痛苦的经历之一，我还是会做出同样的决定。

sentences.en: I would not conceal that.
sentences.zh: 我不会隐瞒这一点。

sentences.en: Matt, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 马特，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Great to be here, Michael.
sentences.zh: 很高兴来到这里，迈克尔。

sentences.en: At Wednesday's hearing,
sentences.zh: 在周三的听证会上，

sentences.en: Comey disclosed some new information about the investigation into Clinton's emails.
sentences.zh: 科米披露了一些关于克林顿邮件调查的新信息。

sentences.en: He told senators that Clinton's top aide,
sentences.zh: 他告诉参议员，克林顿的首席助手，

sentences.en: Huma Abedin, appeared to have been forwarding emails, sometimes classified, to her husband, Anthony Weiner, asking him to print them out
sentences.zh: 胡玛·阿贝丁似乎一直在将邮件，有时是机密邮件，转发给她的丈夫安东尼·韦纳，让他打印出来，

sentences.en: so that she could give them to Hillary Clinton.
sentences.zh: 以便她能交给希拉里·克林顿。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Cheryl, how many abortion clinics are in the state of Kentucky right now?
sentences.zh: 谢丽尔，肯塔基州现在有多少家堕胎诊所？

sentences.en: One.
sentences.zh: 一家。

sentences.en: Just one?
sentences.zh: 只有一家？

sentences.en: Just one.
sentences.zh: 只有一家。

sentences.en: Cheryl Stolberg is a national correspondent at The Times.
sentences.zh: 谢丽尔·斯托尔伯格是《时报》的全国记者。

sentences.en: And what's happening in Kentucky right now that would explain that?
sentences.zh: 肯塔基州现在发生了什么导致了这种情况？

sentences.en: Well, what's happening in Kentucky is the governor of Kentucky,
sentences.zh: 嗯，肯塔基州发生的事情是，肯塔基州州长，

sentences.en: This is not a game.
sentences.zh: 这不是游戏。

sentences.en: Matt Bevan.
sentences.zh: 马特·贝文。

sentences.en: You look at the degradation of things that are happening in our society.
sentences.zh: 看看我们社会中正在发生的退化。

sentences.en: You look at the atrocity of abortion.
sentences.zh: 看看堕胎这种暴行。

sentences.en: So many have remained silent.
sentences.zh: 太多人保持沉默了。

sentences.en: Who is a Republican who calls himself
sentences.zh: 他是一位自称

sentences.en: unapologetically pro-life.
sentences.zh: 毫不妥协的“反堕胎主义者”的共和党人。

sentences.en: It's a slippery slope.
sentences.zh: 这是一条滑坡谬误。

sentences.en: First we're killing children.
sentences.zh: 起初我们是在杀害儿童。

sentences.en: Now it's this gender-bending kind of don't ask, don't be a, you know, a bigot.
sentences.zh: 现在又是这种变性之类的，别问，别做个，你知道，偏执狂。

sentences.en: Don't be unreasonable.
sentences.zh: 别不讲理。

sentences.en: Don't be unenlightened, heaven forbid.
sentences.zh: 别不开化，天哪。

sentences.en: Just keep your mouth shut.
sentences.zh: 闭上你的嘴就行了。

sentences.en: He's blocked a new Planned Parenthood clinic from performing abortions.
sentences.zh: 他阻止了一家新的计划生育诊所进行堕胎手术。

sentences.en: He's moved against and shuttered a clinic in Lexington.
sentences.zh: 他采取行动关闭了列克星敦的一家诊所。

sentences.en: And he's threatened to close this last clinic in Louisville.
sentences.zh: 他还威胁要关闭路易斯维尔的最后这家诊所。

sentences.en: And the clinic is now suing the state, backed by the American Civil Liberties Union.
sentences.zh: 目前该诊所在美国公民自由联盟的支持下正在起诉该州。

sentences.en: And a trial is set for September.
sentences.zh: 审判定于九月进行。

sentences.en: Cheryl, how do you legally close an abortion clinic?
sentences.zh: 谢丽尔，你如何从法律上关闭一家堕胎诊所？

sentences.en: Well, the governor's moved in a couple of ways.
sentences.zh: 嗯，州长采取了几种方式。

sentences.en: In the case of Planned Parenthood,
sentences.zh: 以计划生育协会为例，

sentences.en: Planned Parenthood built a brand new clinic in Louisville under the preceding governor, a Democrat.
sentences.zh: 计划生育协会在前任民主党州长任内，在路易斯维尔建立了一家全新的诊所。

sentences.en: It's a reproductive health clinic.
sentences.zh: 这是一家生殖健康诊所。

sentences.en: It offers a broad array of services.
sentences.zh: 它提供广泛的服务。

sentences.en: And it built the clinic with the full expectation that it would be able to perform abortions.
sentences.zh: 它建立这家诊所时，完全预期它能够进行堕胎手术。

sentences.en: The state says the clinic lacks necessary transfer agreements.
sentences.zh: 州政府称该诊所缺乏必要的转诊协议。

sentences.en: These are agreements that the clinic has with hospitals and ambulance services to transfer women out of the clinic in case of emergency.
sentences.zh: 这些是诊所与医院和救护车服务机构签署的协议，以便在紧急情况下将妇女从诊所转移出去。

sentences.en: And this is news to me, but states have a lot of tools and ways to throw up barriers and make it very hard to operate a clinic that provides abortion.
sentences.zh: 这对我是个新闻，但各州有很多工具和方法来设置障碍，使提供堕胎服务的诊所很难运营。

sentences.en: Yeah, states have a lot of tools.
sentences.zh: 是的，各州有很多工具。

sentences.en: And state legislatures have a lot of tools.
sentences.zh: 州议会也有很多工具。

sentences.en: So around the country, states have been enacting increasingly aggressive restrictions on abortion, restrictions on the procedure, say no abortions after 20 weeks.
sentences.zh: 因此，在全国范围内，各州一直在制定越来越激进的堕胎限制措施，比如对程序的限制，比如20周后禁止堕胎。

sentences.en: In Kentucky, the legislature recently passed a bill requiring doctors to narrate an ultrasound, whether or not the patients want it.
sentences.zh: 在肯塔基州，立法机构最近通过了一项法案，要求医生在超声波检查时进行解说，无论患者是否愿意。

sentences.en: That doesn't go to whether or not a clinic can stay open.
sentences.zh: 这与诊所能否继续营业无关。

sentences.en: But, you know, there are sort of a variety of ways that states and state legislatures can kind of chip away at Roe v.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，各州和州议会有各种各样的方法来削弱“罗诉韦德案”，

sentences.en: Wade that have made it hard for clinics to do business in some cases.
sentences.zh: 这使得诊所在某些情况下很难开展业务。

sentences.en: And you visited this final clinic in Kentucky.
sentences.zh: 你参观了肯塔基州的这家最后诊所。

sentences.en: What did you hear from the physicians there?
sentences.zh: 你从那里的医生那里听到了什么？

sentences.en: Well, I interviewed one doctor there.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我采访了那里的一位医生。

sentences.en: He's been performing abortions very quietly in Kentucky for 37 years.
sentences.zh: 他在肯塔基州非常低调地进行堕胎手术已经37年了。

sentences.en: He actually founded this clinic in 1981 with two partners, both of whom are now dead.
sentences.zh: 他实际上是在1981年与两位合伙人共同创立了这家诊所，他们现在都去世了。

sentences.en: He kind of feels like the last man standing in a way.
sentences.zh: 他在某种程度上觉得自己是最后一个人了。

sentences.en: He told me we're under assault.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，我们正受到攻击。

sentences.en: He feels very strongly that women should have the right to control their own reproductive health.
sentences.zh: 他非常坚定地认为，女性应该有权控制自己的生殖健康。

sentences.en: He's an African-American man and his mother had 10 children and she also had three miscarriages.
sentences.zh: 他是一位非裔美国人，他的母亲生了10个孩子，也流产过3次。

sentences.en: And he told me that he always felt that his mother was a slave to her reproduction, that that is what prompted him to begin offering abortions
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，他一直觉得他的母亲是她生育能力的奴隶，这就是促使他开始在肯塔基州提供堕胎服务的原因，

sentences.en: as part of routine OB-GYN care in Kentucky.
sentences.zh: 作为常规妇产科护理的一部分。

sentences.en: He also told me that many OB-GYNs in Kentucky oppose abortion.
sentences.zh: 他还告诉我，肯塔基州的许多妇产科医生反对堕胎。

sentences.en: And I've heard this from women also in Kentucky, that some who seek abortions are afraid to tell their own OB-GYNs because there's such a stigma attached to it.
sentences.zh: 我也从肯塔基州的女性那里听到过，一些寻求堕胎的人不敢告诉自己的妇产科医生，因为这上面贴着太大的污名。

sentences.en: And you could really feel that stigma in the clinic.
sentences.zh: 你真的能在诊所里感受到那种污名。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: Well, first of all, there were protests outside.
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先，外面有抗议活动。

sentences.en: God hates the hand of innocent blood.
sentences.zh: 上帝憎恨无辜者的鲜血。

sentences.en: Thou shall not murder.
sentences.zh: 不可谋杀。

sentences.en: You ever heard of those?
sentences.zh: 你听说过这些吗？

sentences.en: So women have to go through this phalanx of protesters just to get in.
sentences.zh: 所以女性必须穿过这群抗议者才能进去。

sentences.en: I don't kill children.
sentences.zh: 我不杀孩子。

sentences.en: I raise children.
sentences.zh: 我抚养孩子。

sentences.en: But you slaughter children, which is worse than abusing children, worse than not paying child support.
sentences.zh: 但你屠杀孩子，这比虐待孩子更糟糕，比不支付子女抚养费更糟糕。

sentences.en: You kill them!
sentences.zh: 你杀了他们！

sentences.en: And then inside, one woman told the clinic counselor that she really wrestled with this decision to have an abortion, that she was a religious woman,
sentences.zh: 而在里面，一位女性告诉诊所咨询师，她真的在堕胎这个决定上挣扎，她是一位虔诚的女性，

sentences.en: but she was trying to escape an abusive relationship.
sentences.zh: 但她正试图逃离一段虐待关系。

sentences.en: And she said that she had cried a lot over it and she hoped that God would understand.
sentences.zh: 她说她为此哭了很多次，她希望上帝能理解。

sentences.en: And she said, we need this option.
sentences.zh: 她说，我们需要这个选择。

sentences.en: Cheryl, did you speak to the people outside the clinic who were protesting abortion and who maybe were involved in electing this governor
sentences.zh: 谢丽尔，你有没有和诊所外抗议堕胎的人交谈过，他们可能参与了选举这位州长，

sentences.en: and trying to make abortion hard, if not impossible, in the state?
sentences.zh: 并试图让堕胎在州内变得困难，甚至不可能？

sentences.en: What did they say?
sentences.zh: 他们说了什么？

sentences.en: I did, and he is a hero to them.
sentences.zh: 我谈过了，对他们来说，他就是英雄。

sentences.en: There are protests outside the clinic every single day.
sentences.zh: 诊所外每天都有抗议活动。

sentences.en: You sinners are in big, big trouble with God.
sentences.zh: 你们这些罪人，上帝绝不会轻饶你们。

sentences.en: There are many regulars.
sentences.zh: 常客很多。

sentences.en: There's one woman whose name is Donna who comes every day and she drives a white Mercedes and in the back of her car there's a Virgin Mary statue strapped into the seat belt.
sentences.zh: 有个叫唐娜的女人每天都来，她开着一辆白色奔驰，后座上还用安全带绑着一尊圣母玛利亚雕像。

sentences.en: Every day she tries to usher women who are headed for the clinic into another center nearby, right next door, in fact, that is a Christian crisis pregnancy counseling center.
sentences.zh: 她每天都试图把那些要去诊所的女性引到附近另一个中心，事实上就在隔壁，那是一家基督教危机怀孕咨询中心。

sentences.en: A lot of the protesters outside the clinic are men and they come in various stripes.
sentences.zh: 诊所外的抗议者大多是男性，他们来自各行各业。

sentences.en: There are some men who just stand outside and quietly pray and finger rosary beads.
sentences.zh: 有些男人只是站在外面静静地祈祷，拨动着念珠。

sentences.en: Besides, there's one pastor named Joseph Spurgeon who is very...
sentences.zh: 此外，还有一位名叫约瑟夫·斯珀金的牧师，他非常……

sentences.en: What you're about to do will be the killing of your child.
sentences.zh: 你们即将做的事就是杀害你们的孩子。

sentences.en: I would say aggressive.
sentences.zh: 我想说，很有攻击性。

sentences.en: The murder of your son or daughter.
sentences.zh: 谋杀你们的儿子或女儿。

sentences.en: In his protesting, he stands outside the clinic with a bullhorn and he...
sentences.zh: 在抗议时，他站在诊所外拿着扩音器，然后……

sentences.en: Anything is better than killing your child.
sentences.zh: 什么都比杀掉孩子强。

sentences.en: ...shouts toward the clinic so that the women in the waiting room can hear him.
sentences.zh: ……对着诊所大喊，好让候诊室里的女性都能听见。

sentences.en: To take the life of your son or daughter is murder.
sentences.zh: 夺走你们儿子或女儿的生命就是谋杀。

sentences.en: When I was there, a young woman was carrying a toddler and she carried her toddler with her into the clinic and one of the protesters screamed at her,
sentences.zh: 我在那里时，一位年轻女性抱着个蹒跚学步的孩子走进诊所，其中一名抗议者对她尖叫道：

sentences.en: you're taking a baby into an abortion clinic where they're going to kill another baby.
sentences.zh: 你竟然带着孩子进堕胎诊所，他们正打算在那里杀掉另一个婴儿。

sentences.en: All of these women come into the clinic escorted by volunteers who are wearing orange vests.
sentences.zh: 所有这些女性都是在身穿橙色背心的志愿者护送下进入诊所的。

sentences.en: But as far as the protesters,
sentences.zh: 但就抗议者而言，

sentences.en: obviously they are delighted with their governor and they feel he's ending a scourge or seeking to end a scourge in the state.
sentences.zh: 显然他们对州长感到非常高兴，觉得他正在结束或试图结束州内的一场祸害。

sentences.en: It feels like what you're describing points at some of the divisiveness across the country right now.
sentences.zh: 你所描述的情况似乎指向了目前全国范围内存在的一些分歧。

sentences.en: And I wonder, for example, if you could contrast the situation in Kentucky with a democratically controlled state.
sentences.zh: 我想知道，比如，你能不能对比一下肯塔基州和一个民主党控制的州的情况？

sentences.en: How many abortion providers are there in a state like New York, for example?
sentences.zh: 以纽约州为例，那里有多少堕胎服务提供者？

sentences.en: You know, the situation is really night and day.
sentences.zh: 你知道，情况真是天差地别。

sentences.en: The Guttmacher Institute, which tracks abortion policy, says that as of 2014,
sentences.zh: 追踪堕胎政策的古特马赫研究所表示，截至2014年，

sentences.en: 218 abortion providers were in New York,
sentences.zh: 纽约州有218家堕胎服务提供者，

sentences.en: 95 of them abortion clinics.
sentences.zh: 其中95家是堕胎诊所。

sentences.en: So the access is, you know, almost unfettered in New York as compared to Kentucky, where it is so difficult in so many ways.
sentences.zh: 所以，与肯塔基州相比，纽约州的堕胎渠道几乎是畅通无阻的，而在肯塔基州，各方面都非常困难。

sentences.en: One OB-GYN in Kentucky, in rural eastern Kentucky, told me that she had trained in New Jersey and that she was so shocked because in New Jersey,
sentences.zh: 肯塔基州东部农村地区的一位妇产科医生告诉我，她曾在新泽西州受训，当时她感到非常震惊，因为在新泽西州，

sentences.en: if a woman wanted to terminate a pregnancy, she'd likely just either go to a clinic or go to her OB-GYN and it would be done and that would be it.
sentences.zh: 如果女性想要终止妊娠，她很可能只需要去诊所或找自己的妇产科医生，事情就解决了。

sentences.en: And in Kentucky, the hurdles are so vaSt.
sentences.zh: 而在肯塔基州，障碍实在太多了。

sentences.en: First of all, it's a large state.
sentences.zh: 首先，这是一个很大的州。

sentences.en: Now there's only one clinic left.
sentences.zh: 现在只剩下一家诊所了。

sentences.en: Women have to travel maybe for, you know, several hundred miles
sentences.zh: 女性可能不得不长途跋涉几百英里

sentences.en: to get there.
sentences.zh: 才能到达那里。

sentences.en: Previously, women could go maybe in the western part of the state, maybe they'd go to Nashville where there was a clinic.
sentences.zh: 以前，女性或许可以去该州西部，或者去纳什维尔，那里有一家诊所。

sentences.en: But now Tennessee has enacted
sentences.zh: 但现在田纳西州已经实施了

sentences.en: 48-hour waiting periods.
sentences.zh: 48小时的等待期。

sentences.en: So that means two trips to the clinic.
sentences.zh: 这意味着要去诊所两趟。

sentences.en: That makes it all the more difficult for a woman to get herself there.
sentences.zh: 这让女性前往诊所变得更加困难。

sentences.en: The surrounding states like Ohio and Tennessee are also enacting restrictions, limiting access.
sentences.zh: 俄亥俄州和田纳西州等周边州也在实施限制措施，限制堕胎渠道。

sentences.en: Kentucky's not the only state that has just one abortion clinic.
sentences.zh: 肯塔基州并不是唯一一个只有一家堕胎诊所的州。

sentences.en: There are seven.
sentences.zh: 这样的州有七个。

sentences.en: In fact, West Virginia just dropped down to one abortion clinic just this year.
sentences.zh: 事实上，西弗吉尼亚州今年也减少到只剩一家堕胎诊所了。

sentences.en: So there's really this patchwork across the country around access to abortion that is very, very striking.
sentences.zh: 所以，全国各地的堕胎渠道确实呈现出一种非常引人注目的拼凑状态。

sentences.en: So what's likely to happen in Kentucky?
sentences.zh: 那么肯塔基州接下来会发生什么呢？

sentences.en: Does it seem likely that this clinic, this final clinic in a state will be closed?
sentences.zh: 这家州内最后的诊所看起来会被关闭吗？

sentences.en: If I were betting, just based on the judge's preliminary order, the final clinic will probably remain open.
sentences.zh: 如果让我打赌，仅根据法官的初步裁定，这家最后的诊所很可能会继续营业。

sentences.en: And that's because the judge said that the clinic had a strong likelihood of success.
sentences.zh: 这是因为法官表示，该诊所胜诉的可能性很大。

sentences.en: And the ACLU, which is handling this case, says that should this clinic close, there would be an effective ban on abortion in Kentucky.
sentences.zh: 而负责此案的美国公民自由联盟（ACLU）表示，如果这家诊所关闭，肯塔基州实际上将禁止堕胎。

sentences.en: And after all,
sentences.zh: 毕竟，

sentences.en: Roe v.
sentences.zh: “罗诉韦德案”

sentences.en: Wade is still the law of the land.
sentences.zh: 仍然是全国通用的法律。

sentences.en: So I think the betting is that the clinic will in the end be able to remain open.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，大家赌的是这家诊所最终能够继续营业。

sentences.en: But it's not going to happen without a fight.
sentences.zh: 但这不会不经过一番斗争就实现。

sentences.en: Thank you, Cheryl.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，谢丽尔。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: The Times reports that President Trump plans to mark the National Day of Prayer today by signing an executive order that would make it easier for religious groups
sentences.zh: 《泰晤士报》报道称，特朗普总统计划在今天的“全国祈祷日”签署一项行政命令，旨在让宗教团体更容易

sentences.en: to participate in politics.
sentences.zh: 参与政治活动。

sentences.en: Under current federal law, religious groups can lose their tax-exempt status by supporting or opposing a candidate, a restriction that Trump says denies religious leaders
sentences.zh: 根据现行联邦法律，宗教团体如果支持或反对某位候选人，可能会失去免税资格，特朗普称这一限制剥夺了宗教领袖

sentences.en: their right to free speech.
sentences.zh: 的言论自由权。

sentences.en: And two Republican lawmakers who had come out against the House plan to repeal the Affordable Care Act have reversed course and are supporting it after the plan
sentences.zh: 此外，两名曾反对众议院废除《平价医疗法案》计划的共和党议员已经改变立场，在计划更新以向患有既往症的人群提供更多支持后，

sentences.en: updated to offer more support to people with pre-existing medical conditions.
sentences.zh: 他们转而支持该计划。

sentences.en: So we're making good progress on some improvements to the bill.
sentences.zh: 我们正在对该法案的一些改进工作取得良好进展。

sentences.en: We've got some momentum and so we feel really good about that.
sentences.zh: 我们已经有了一些势头，所以我们对此感觉非常好。

sentences.en: Speaker Paul Ryan and other Republican leaders are trying to round up the votes to push the bill through the House today.
sentences.zh: 众议院议长保罗·瑞安和其他共和党领导人正试图争取选票，以推动该法案今天在众议院获得通过。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是今天的《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。
